dataset_info.summary: Recordings of people saying “alexa” from Picovoice's public wake-word benchmark, used as the clips a detector must wake on, against negatives pooled from the shared not-wake-word collection. One row is one clip with its label. This is an independently collected set, which makes it a useful check on engines tuned against their own vendor's data.
dataset_info.notes: Picovoice wake-word benchmark — real 'alexa' recordings (data/alexa/) as positives; negatives pooled across the not-wake-word collection.
